phone.notes: Reading a bracelet can no longer lose a Digimon: the bracelet keeps it until it is really imported. Empty cards are removed automatically, and Settings has a new Repair the cards button. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The trained points (PP) now go up on the watch for the Digimon you send from the farm: they were being thrown away because it had no bracelet training window.
